items.source: Interceptor for WebSocket handshake requests. Can be used to inspect the handshake request and response as well as to pass attributes to the target WebSocketHandler.
items.translation: WebSocket 握手请求的拦截器。可用于检查握手请求和响应，以及向目标 WebSocketHandler 传递属性。

items.source: Invoked before the handshake is processed.

Invoked after the handshake is done. The response status and headers indicate
the results of the handshake, i.e. whether it was successful or not.
items.translation: 在握手完成后调用。响应状态和标头指示握手的结果，即是否成功。

items.source: whether to proceed with the handshake (true) or abort (false)
exception - an exception raised during the handshake, or null if none
items.translation: exception - 握手期间抛出的异常，或若无异常则为 null

items.source: Invoked after the handshake is done.
attributes - the attributes from the HTTP handshake to associate with the WebSocket session; the provided attributes are copied, the original map is not used.
items.translation: attributes - 要与 WebSocket 会话关联的来自 HTTP 握手的信息；提供的属性会被复制，不会使用原始映射。
